plantText:
Pot and leaves in the shot.
That is what shows the species.
tipsSubtitle: Three things that change the result.
tipsWholeText: A close-up of a single leaf can rarely identify the species.
tipsLightText: Dark or blurry photos are what fails to read most often.
tipsSingleText: With two in frame, the answer may be about the one you did not mean.
tipsExtra: If a leaf is spotted or has bugs, make sure that part is clearly in frame.
